claim_one_line: THE SM SPECIFICATION LEDGER (owner directive: we do not yet fully understand the SM as today's science understands it, in order to know what our side should provide). PRIOR-ART GREP FIRST, per the new seal-provenance discipline: the repo had TWO SM-facing documents and NEITHER is an inventory of the SM itself -- INPUT_COMPLETENESS_LEDGER governs HOW to compare (scheme, scale, uncertainties, look-elsewhere, the matched null) and never says what the SM IS, while LITERATURE_GAUGE_SM is a month-old map OF THE LITERATURE. So the programme had been comparing against a target it never wrote down. docs/SM_SPECIFICATION_LEDGER.md now states it: the gauge algebra and its global Z/6 form, the 15 (16 with nu^c) Weyl fermions per generation with exact hypercharges, the scalar sector, the NINETEEN free parameters (26 with Dirac neutrinos, 28 with Majorana), the FORCED-versus-MEASURED split of today's physics, and a per-row column for what this object has delivered. THE FIRST FRUIT, CAUGHT WHILE WRITING THE GAUGE ROW: B892 banks 'z(x1,y*) = su(3) + su(2) + u(1)^3 EXACTLY -- two measurements take E6 to the Standard Model algebra', with its own arithmetic dim 14, derived 11, centre 3. But su(3)+su(2)+u(1)^3 has dimension 14 and THE STANDARD MODEL GAUGE ALGEBRA HAS DIMENSION 12: su(3)+su(2)+u(1), ONE abelian factor, not three. The mathematics is right and undisturbed -- 8+3+3 = 14 is exactly what B892 computed and locked -- but THE SENTENCE WRAPPED AROUND IT OVERSTATES BY TWO ABELIAN FACTORS. This is NOT a refutation: extra U(1)s are entirely standard in GUT descent (SO(10) -> SM leaves U(1)_{B-L}, and rank-6 E6 reaching rank-4 SM must shed rank somewhere), so the structural result stands; what changes is its distance from the target -- THE CHAIN IS TWO STEPS FROM THE SM, NOT ZERO -- with both steps now named: which u(1) or combination is hypercharge (the gauge_dict obstacle, 48/79 per B949), and what breaks the other two. This is exactly the failure mode the directive predicted: not knowing the target precisely enough to notice that 'lands on the Standard Model algebra' had been banked for something that is the SM algebra plus u(1)^2. THE SHARPEST TARGET THE LEDGER IDENTIFIES: the ledger's forced-versus-measured section isolates that THE HYPERCHARGES ARE THE SM'S ONLY COMPUTED VALUE-LEVEL STRUCTURE, fixed up to normalisation by anomaly cancellation as a Diophantine system. Since the object supplies a rank-3 abelian sector, the question 'do the object's own charges satisfy the SM's anomaly conditions, and does Y fall out?' is value-level but NOT value-matching (anomaly cancellation is integer equations, not a measured number), so the firewall permits it; it aims at the one row where accepted physics DERIVES rather than measures, so a result there is intelligible without any crossing; and it is the natural successor to B892, whose section 4 already reports a hypercharge fit reproducing 'at rank 3' without deriving anything from it. Registered L132, not run here. THE HONEST SCORECARD: of what a complete picture needs from the un-derived column, we have the algebra up to two extra U(1)s, the generation count structurally, chirality only via an inserted closing, no values, and nothing on the global Z/6 form, strong CP, hierarchy, neutrino mass, dark matter or gravity. And sin^2 theta_W = 3/8 belongs in the FORCED column, not the achievement column -- it is a known GUT relation and the arc that ran it to M_Z missed at 16 sigma; the ledger now REQUIRES every SM-facing cell to say 'reproduced' rather than 'predicted' for anything forced.
